about: Reviewed starting inputs for the font-ots target. The first byte picks the damaged table (low three bits modulo 5: head, cmap, GSUB, post, name), the post version (bits 3-4: 2.0, 1.0, 3.0, 2.0), a format 1 naming table (bit 5) and cutting the table short (bit 6, to the next byte's fraction of 256); the rest are three-byte patches: position in the table (two bytes, wrapped) and value.

seeds.why: cmap: format 4 glyph past the font through a delta (first segment's delta high byte)
cmap: subtable offset past the table
GSUB: lookup list offset past the table
post 2.0: glyph count other than maxp's (byte 33)
post 2.0: a stored name with a zero byte, or past the end (patched in the strings)
post 2.0: cut short inside the stored names
name: string storage inside the records (byte 5)
name: a record's string past the end (accepted; never chosen)
name format 1: language tag past the end (its offset, byte 94 in the smaller font)
name: unknown platform on the Windows family record (accepted)
